name: cloudtak-plugin-measure
description: Caltopo-style ruler for CloudTAK — distance, bearing and terrain profile without creating a CoT feature
comment: Dependencies are intentionally empty. This plugin is bundled by Vite from ~/CloudTAK/api/web and resolves all imports (terra-draw, turf, vue, maplibre-gl) against that project's node_modules via the symlinked-plugin-resolve plugin in api/web/vite.config.js. Do not npm install here.
